_comment: What tools/features/status.py cannot find out by itself. For every PlantUML diagram factory: the Rust modules that port it (relative to crates/rockuml/src), or else a status (soon, later, never) and the reason. Commands, built-in functions, flags and formats are ported when rockuml names them; the entries here only explain the ones that are not.

DescriptionDiagramFactory.title: Use case, component, deployment and ArchiMate diagrams

TimingDiagramFactory.title: Timing diagrams
TimingDiagramFactory.notes: Dates print in UTC; `use date format` knows the common SimpleDateFormat letters.

WBSDiagramFactory.title: Work breakdown structures
WBSDiagramFactory.notes: The ASCII-art output is not ported (txt formats are planned later).

GanttDiagramFactory.title: Gantt charts
GanttDiagramFactory.notes: Working hours are not ported yet; `today` without a date is today in UTC.

PSystemSaltFactory.title: Wireframes (Salt)
PSystemSaltFactory.notes: `salt` inside `@startuml` and `{{ … }}` embedded diagrams are not ported yet.

ActivityDiagramFactory.title: Legacy activity diagrams (`(*) --> "Action"`)
ActivityDiagramFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan: the current activity syntax covers the same diagrams.

BpmDiagramFactory.title: BPM diagrams
BpmDiagramFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan, ported on demand.

PSystemDitaaFactory.title: Ditaa diagrams
PSystemDitaaFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan: a port of the vendored ditaa code, about 10 000 lines.

PSystemDotFactory.title: Graphviz sources (`@startdot`)
PSystemDotFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan: needs an external `dot` or a port of more of Graphviz.

ChartDiagramFactory.title: Charts
ChartDiagramFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan, ported on demand.

PacketDiagramFactory.title: Packet diagrams
PacketDiagramFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan, ported on demand.

FlowDiagramFactory.title: Flow diagrams
FlowDiagramFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan, ported on demand.

WireDiagramFactory.title: Wire diagrams
WireDiagramFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan, ported on demand.

GitDiagramFactory.title: Git diagrams
GitDiagramFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan, ported on demand.

FilesDiagramFactory.title: File trees
FilesDiagramFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan, ported on demand.

BoardDiagramFactory.title: Boards
BoardDiagramFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan, ported on demand.

HclDiagramFactory.title: HCL data
HclDiagramFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan, ported on demand.

PSystemEbnfFactory.title: EBNF diagrams
PSystemEbnfFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan, ported on demand.

PSystemRegexFactory.title: Regular expression diagrams
PSystemRegexFactory.reason: Tier 3 of the plan, ported on demand.

PSystemMathFactory.title: Math (`@startmath`)
PSystemMathFactory.reason: Needs a TeX math layout engine, which PlantUML borrows from JLaTeXMath; the approach is still to be chosen.

PSystemLatexFactory.title: LaTeX math (`@startlatex`)
PSystemLatexFactory.reason: Needs a TeX math layout engine, which PlantUML borrows from JLaTeXMath; the approach is still to be chosen.

PSystemDefinitionFactory.title: Definitions drawn on their own (`@startdef`)
PSystemDefinitionFactory.reason: Definitions work with `!includedef`; drawing them on their own is rarely needed.

HelpFactory.title: Help diagrams (`help keywords`, …)
HelpFactory.reason: PlantUML's built-in reference cards; low priority.

PSystemWelcomeFactory.title: The welcome screen of an empty diagram

PSystemOpenIconicFactory.title: An Open Iconic icon on its own (`openiconic`)

PSystemDonorsFactory.title: PlantUML's donors
PSystemDonorsFactory.reason: About PlantUML itself, not about diagrams.

CrashDiagramFactory.title: Crash reports (`@startcrash`)
CrashDiagramFactory.reason: PlantUML's way of testing its crash report; rockuml reports crashes on the command line.

CommandSkin.reason: Old skins are superseded by themes and styles.

CommandSkinParamJaws.reason: A `skinparam` line with line breaks inside, which only macros produce.

PDF.reason: Next on the plan (Tier 2), through svg2pdf.

HTML5.reason: PlantUML's HTML5 canvas output; SVG covers browsers.

BRAILLE_PNG.reason: Dropped in the plan; may be reconsidered on request.

_default.reason: Tier 3 of the plan, ported on demand.

cliFlags._dropped: Belongs to PlantUML's Java runtime or GUI, which rockuml does not have.
cliFlags._notPorted: Recognised and refused with a message; ported on demand.

_default.reason: Part of the preprocessor, which is ported; missing functions are ported as found.
